column1: # truth-calibrate, 2026-09-29. App at 246f3d5 (score-gate, default settings) on scans made by ops/truth/make-scans.sh.
# Truth: the source's own PDFKit text (real) or synth-pages' .txt (synthetic). wer is order-sensitive; bag is order-free lost words.

# reader_* columns: see the per-page block below (procedure v2, one page per layout and kind). Real-book rows: the truth is Canby's own layer, which is old OCR (ERACE, gUINN 1::), so the app's real-book figures above are against a flawed truth.
# Per page, 2026-09-29 second session: one page (seed 1, or p2 for real) per layout and kind. fair_lost = order-free lost truth words after folding case and punctuation,
# splitting on dashes and merging truth fragments (apply-check.py). reader_fair_lost is procedure v2, over uncontested words only; reader_nocheck is the transcript before any check.
# checked = reader words that differed from the app's reading and were cross-checked; contested = v2 words left unscored; 'not run' = no cross-check (v2 can only lower the error).
# reader_missing_lines = truth lines of 3+ words with under half their words in the transcript. Usage: reader subagent tokens and seconds (a check reader: ~37k tokens per 50 words).
